name: a2a
description: Lets one of your Bots ask another Bot a question and get that Bot's own answer, from its own memory and tools, in its own thread. Speaks the A2A v1.0 JSON-RPC protocol on the gateway's existing authenticated routes and opens no port of its own. You decide which Bot may ask which; everything else is refused. Peer questions are answer-only, at most 5 turns per conversation by default (up to 10), and every exchange is logged. Optional Chief of Staff mode: one Bot you pick runs roll calls, collects escalations from the others and, only if you turn it on, assigns work that waits for your Approve unless you choose a looser approval mode.
author: subnetangel
highlights: A Bot asks another Bot and gets that Bot's own answer, from its live thread with its own memory
No new listener: Agent Card and JSON-RPC ride the gateway's own authenticated routes
Deny by default: you list which Bot may ask which
Answer-only scope, 5 turns per conversation by default (owner limit up to 10), peer text fenced as untrusted data
Credentials scrubbed both ways and every exchange in an audit log
Ask several Bots at once (a2a_orchestrate) inside an owner-set Bot and time budget
One press turns A2A on for every Bot, after showing every change
Health per Bot, with Repair: a mount that survives Kiro Crew upgrades
Live activity feed by conversation and orchestration run, refusals marked
An A2A tab in each Bot's chat side panel: its health, pairs, conversations and open tasks
Chief of Staff mode: one Bot you pick may ask every Bot at once; the others are held to a smaller fan-out
Roll call: one status question to every Bot, merged into a brief with overlapping tickets flagged; optional daily schedule, off by default
Escalation inbox: any Bot can flag what needs you, de-duplicated, with Done and Dismiss
Assignments (off by default): the Chief of Staff assigns work that follows Kiro Crew's approval modes, Approve by default, never widening a Bot's tools
